description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT (Devastator Brethren, 1 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Marines, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). In the Ork player's Shooting phase the Flash Gitz are selected to shoot and target the Hellblaster Squad (ASSIGN_TARGET + Confirm Targets — the shooting panel's actions); the defender's reactive dialog (the enemy_targets_unit_shooting window folded in) offers ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT; a real click spends 1 CP; attacks that target the Hellblasters have -1 AP until the Flash Gitz have attacked.

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Space Marines player gets the eight WP-M2b detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the other player 0 CP (no stratagem windows not under test)
steps.equals: Terminator Storm Force + Assault Brethren + Gravis Linebreaker Force + Devastator Brethren + Gravis Siege Force + Tactical Brethren + Ironclad Champions + Tacticus Firestorm Force

steps.comment: setup privilege: straight to the phase under test
a window not under test (if any) is declined
the Ork player's shooting panel unit pick
the Ork player's own unit_selected_to_shoot window (if any) declined
the Ork player targets the Hellblasters (ASSIGN_TARGET + Confirm Targets)
REAL click (the Space Marines player) on the stratagem's Use button
attacks that target the Hellblasters have -1 AP
